verdict.rationale: Recurly ships several rule-based automations that run autonomously once configured (dunning/retry management, Account Updater, backup payment methods, automatic entitlement granting, and RevRec's automated contract-modification/revenue recognition), showing real 'set-and-forget' background processing. However, none of this is framed as an AI-native or agent-driven automation-setup capability — the only AI-agent touchpoint (Compass MCP) is described purely as a documentation/API knowledge connector for coding assistants, not a way for an agent to configure or run autonomous billing workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-configurable automation workflows, agent-triggered background tasks, or any agentic orchestration beyond static rule-based billing logic.
